title: TIFF stack
description: A multi-page TIFF file, read as height x width x frames; pages of several samples (RGB) as height x width x samples x frames, and a file series per channel (rec_ch1_part_001.tif, rec_ch2_part_001.tif, ...) as height x width x channels x frames. Python needs tifffile (pip install "nansen-core[ophys]").
